# Bank Accounts

Part of the **Partners** API. Base URL `https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1` — replace the host with your own installation and the token placeholder with a real Bearer token (see [Authentication](/master/api-reference/authentication)).

## List bank accounts

<Badge type="tip" text="GET" /> `/admin/api/v1/partners/partners/{partner_id}/bank-accounts`

Retrieve a paginated list of bank accounts for a specific partner with filtering and sorting

> 🔒 Requires a valid Bearer token.

**Path parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `partner_id` | integer | Yes | The partner ID |


**Query parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description | Example |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|---------|
| `include` | string | No | Comma-separated list of relationships to include. Available options: bank, creator | `bank` |
| `filter[id]` | string | No | Comma-separated list of IDs to filter by |  |
| `filter[bank_id]` | string | No | Comma-separated list of bank IDs to filter by |  |
| `filter[trashed]` | string | No | Filter by trashed status. Available options: with, without, only |  |
| `sort` | string | Yes | Sort field | `created_at` |
| `page` | integer | Yes | Page number | `1` |



::: code-group

```bash [cURL]
curl -X GET "https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/partners/partners/{partner_id}/bank-accounts?include=bank&sort=created_at&page=1" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}" \
  -H "Accept: application/json" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"
```

```javascript [JavaScript]
const response = await fetch("https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/partners/partners/{partner_id}/bank-accounts?include=bank&sort=created_at&page=1", {
  method: "GET",
  headers: {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}",
    "Accept": "application/json",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
  },
});

const data = await response.json();
console.log(data);
```

```php [PHP]
<?php

$client = new \GuzzleHttp\Client();

$response = $client->request('GET', 'https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/partners/partners/{partner_id}/bank-accounts?include=bank&sort=created_at&page=1', [
    'headers' => [
        'Authorization' => 'Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}',
        'Accept' => 'application/json',
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
    ],
]);

$data = json_decode($response->getBody(), true);
```

## Create bank account

<Badge type="tip" text="POST" /> `/admin/api/v1/partners/partners/{partner_id}/bank-accounts`

Create a new bank account for a specific partner

> 🔒 Requires a valid Bearer token.

**Path parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `partner_id` | integer | Yes | The partner ID |



**Body parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `account_number` | string | Yes | Bank account number (max 255 characters). Must not be greater than 255 characters. |
| `can_send_money` | boolean | Yes | Whether money can be sent from this account. |
| `bank_id` | integer | Yes | Bank ID. Must match an existing stored value. |


::: code-group

```bash [cURL]
curl -X POST "https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/partners/partners/{partner_id}/bank-accounts" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}" \
  -H "Accept: application/json" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
  "account_number": "1234567890",
  "can_send_money": true,
  "bank_id": 1
}'
```

```javascript [JavaScript]
const response = await fetch("https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/partners/partners/{partner_id}/bank-accounts", {
  method: "POST",
  headers: {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}",
    "Accept": "application/json",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({
  "account_number": "1234567890",
  "can_send_money": true,
  "bank_id": 1
}),
});

const data = await response.json();
console.log(data);
```

```php [PHP]
<?php

$client = new \GuzzleHttp\Client();

$response = $client->request('POST', 'https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/partners/partners/{partner_id}/bank-accounts', [
    'headers' => [
        'Authorization' => 'Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}',
        'Accept' => 'application/json',
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
    ],
    'json' => [
    'account_number' => '1234567890',
    'can_send_money' => true,
    'bank_id' => 1,
  ],
]);

$data = json_decode($response->getBody(), true);
```

```python [Python]
import requests

url = "https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/partners/partners/{partner_id}/bank-accounts"

headers = {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}",
    "Accept": "application/json",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
}

payload = {
    "account_number": "1234567890",
    "can_send_money": True,
    "bank_id": 1,
}

response = requests.post(url, headers=headers, json=payload)

data = response.json()
print(data)
```

:::

**Example response** <Badge type="info" text="201" />

```json

    "account_number": "88002631600564",
```
